parameters.query:
SELECT c.id, c.business_name, c.address, c.suburb, c.email, c.phone, c.stage,
       c.qualification_score, s.code AS segment_code, s.name AS segment_name,
       c.enrichment->'profile' AS profile
FROM leads.candidates c
LEFT JOIN leads.segments s ON s.id = c.segment_id
LEFT JOIN leads.outreach_drafts d ON d.candidate_id = c.id
WHERE c.duplicate_of IS NULL
  AND c.do_not_contact = false
  AND c.excluded_from_outreach = false
  AND c.stage NOT IN ('lost','won','disqualified')
  AND NOT leads.is_cleaning_competitor(c.business_name, c.website, c.email)
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM leads.suppression sp
                  WHERE (sp.email_norm IS NOT NULL
                         AND sp.email_norm = leads.norm_email(c.email))
                     OR (sp.domain_norm IS NOT NULL
                         AND sp.domain_norm = leads.norm_domain(c.website)))
  AND (d.candidate_id IS NULL
       OR (d.status = 'draft' AND d.method NOT LIKE 'ai\_%'
           AND d.method NOT LIKE 'composer\_v3%'))
ORDER BY (c.qualification_score >= 85) DESC,
         c.qualification_score DESC NULLS LAST, c.id
LIMIT 4

INSERT INTO leads.outreach_drafts (candidate_id, subject, body, method) SELECT d.candidate_id, d.subject, d.body, d.method FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS d(candidate_id bigint, subject text, body text, method text) ON CONFLICT (candidate_id) DO UPDATE SET subject = EXCLUDED.subject, body = EXCLUDED.body, method = EXCLUDED.method, updated_at = now() WHERE leads.outreach_drafts.status = 'draft'
SELECT count(*) AS total_drafts, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'draft') AS pending_review, max(updated_at) AS last_generated FROM leads.outreach_drafts

parameters.content:
## Personalized Outreach Engine v1.1 (draft-only, AI Gateway)

Weekly Mon 08:00: generates personalized first-contact email drafts via the IVNautomation AI Gateway (generate_outreach_v2 / Qwen 3 8B). Top 50 leads by qualification score without a reviewed draft per run. Deterministic context prep (band, segment pitch, suburb, verified owner name) stays in code; language generation is delegated to POST /v1/ai/outreach/initial. Failed AI calls are skipped, retried next run. Reviewed drafts (status != draft) are never overwritten.

NO EMAIL IS SENT by this workflow - it only writes drafts for review in the dashboard.
